svg.aria-label: Keys. Playback: Space: play / pause; n p: next / previous; ← →: seek ±10 s (also , and .); + -: volume ±5%; s: shuffle: off → on → smart; r: repeat: off → all → one; x: crossfade off · 3 · 5 · 8 · 12 s; P: play everything in the list; c: show the queue. Library: f: like · save album · follow artist; a: add to queue; A: add to / remove from a playlist; D D: remove from the open playlist; y: copy link of the highlighted row; Y: copy link of the open list; I: private session on / off. Browse: ↑ ↓ j k: move; g G: top / bottom (PgUp, PgDn); Tab h l: switch pane; Enter: play / open; Esc: back (also Backspace); /: search; o O: next / previous sort order; w: jump to the playing song; u U: open the song's album / artist; R: reload the list. View: L: lyrics; i: album art on / off; t: next colour theme; e E: next EQ preset / EQ panel; ?: every key, in trill; q: quit (pauses first).
svg.text: add to / remove from a playlist
copy link of the highlighted row
copy link of the open list
